warnings.text:
Cloudflare.providers() needs HttpClient, which Axiom.providers() provides, but Layer.mergeAll builds its layers side by side.
  No automatic fix: supplying a dependency changes its provider and the exported requirement. Review the provider and build order before composing manually.
  Use Layer.provide or Layer.provideMerge to supply construction dependencies; Layer.mergeAll builds its layers independently.

FcmClientError extends Schema.TaggedError; a schema error declaration, schema error FcmClientError { … }, writes the same failure with its Schema.
  No quick fix: the optional codec accepts undefined; keep the explicit Effect class to preserve its schema API.

DpopProofReplayPersistenceError extends Schema.TaggedError; a schema error declaration, schema error DpopProofReplayPersistenceError { … }, writes the same failure with its Schema.
  No quick fix: the field thumbprint is an optional key, which a schema error's ? does not write.

RelayTransactions extends Context.Service; in VibeLang a service is a service declaration: service RelayTransactions { … }.
  No quick fix: move its static members into the declaration. Keep its key in the declaration: static readonly key = "t3code-relay/db/RelayTransactions".
